summary: Sandbach United are in excellent form heading into a crucial run of fixtures, sitting near the top of the table after a 4-1 cup victory over Foley Meir with goals from Max Williams, Joshua Fowles, Kyle Foley and Matthew Birchall. The Reds face Cheadle Nomads in their next league outing before a big Senior Cup clash against Stockport County at home, followed by a challenging sequence against Bilston Town, AFC Bridgnorth and Dawley Town. With five consecutive home games and a squad clearly firing on all cylinders, it's an exciting period for the club.
